notes.title: Big update: Photo Mode!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,



To celebrate our participation in the Wholesome Games Celebration, we’ve prepared a major update just for you!

Did you play the demo and miss the photo mode in the full game? You loved it back then and we’ve got good news for you.


Photo mode is back! 📸


Capture your album pages in beautiful snapshots to showcase your amazing creations and share them with the world!


Although photo mode was available in the demo earlier in development, we had to remove it at launch due to compatibility issues. But now, it’s back and better than ever!



We’ve fixed all the problems and made some improvements. Your favorite food and beverages are now included in the composition to make your snapshots look their best. 💖



📱 Use the smartphone to take a snapshot of your page

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149248/4c37f99c220f6c4941737f0f0cf7b8cc4a0ea684.png"]

📸 Take the shot...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149248/3bfc521a6aa587b5bf996c7d604824cead7897f3.png"]

🖼️ And voilà! Here’s the final image saved from photo mode!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149248/03e166390d2ab68ff3d19260be12974b24bd32ac.png"]



Take the perfect snapshots, ready to post straight away!

We hope you enjoy this major update. We can’t wait to see your creations captured through the photo mode.



Best,

-Endflame Team 💖

notes.title: Instants Major Update for Steam Deck!
notes.content:
Happy weekend everyone!

First of all, thank you so much for all your comments and feedback. [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f496.png"] It’s been incredibly helpful in preparing this major update for you.


One of the most requested features has been Steam Deck support, and we’ve been working hard to bring it to you today!

While we're still in the process of getting the game officially Steam Deck Verified, we're excited to announce that we've implemented everything needed for a smooth experience on the platform:

Full controller support

Keyboard input for writing tools

Menus adapted to Steam Deck resolution

Start-up videos now play correctly



This update also includes some minor bug fixes to further improve controller gameplay.



We hope you enjoy the update on your Steam Deck, and if you do, please don’t forget to leave a review. We read every single one, and your support means the world to us. [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f48c.png"]



Best,
Endflame team



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149248/3974764006c8a61a303b91c1e1158843096ab268.jpg"]

notes.title: Instants is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The day is finally here: Instants is out now!! 🥳

We can hardly believe it! After months (okay, years) of dreaming, designing, puzzling, and scrapbooking, our cozy little narrative puzzle game is finally ready for you to play. Whether you’ve been following along since the first reveal or just discovered Instants, we’re so excited to share this story with you.

[previewyoutube=cUbNEVRWaJE;full][/previewyoutube]

Grab your favourite cup of tea and piece together a chronological puzzle of family photos to reconstruct their most cherished memories.

Discover the family's life story as you arrange the pictures in the correct order inside the albums. Unleash your creativity and decorate them with multiple scrapbooking tools!

What you'll do in the game:


 🧩 Reconstruct memories
 📖 Uncover a family's journey
 🎨 Decorate and make it your own


We poured so much love into this game, and your support has meant everything along the way, which is why we hope Instants brings you comfort, joy, and maybe even a few tears (the good kind).

Thanks for being here. 💖
See you in Instants,

-Endflame Team

notes.title: Play the demo during the Steam Next Fest with its BIG Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As you may already know, Steam Next Fest is here and with it a lot of demos for you to try. We wanted to do something special for this event. So we localized the demo to all the languages of the final game!

🌍 You can play Instants in 11 different languages

We believe demos should give you a glimpse of what the final game will be so you can decide if it's the right game for you before buying it. That's why the quality of the demo of Instants is as close as it can be to the quality of the final game, and that includes the languages. We want everyone to enjoy Instants without language being a barrier.

Feedback 💬

We'd love to hear your thoughts on Instants!

If you already tried the demo: 

- Please leave a review on the Steam demo page and let us know what you thought!

And if you haven't tried the demo yet:

- Try the demo and do the previous step☺️

We hope you enjoy it and create fond memories with Instants.

- Endflame Team ❤️

notes.title: Instants Demo Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Are you ready for something cozy? The demo of Instants is finally here to warm your hearts! ✨

Assemble beautiful albums and uncover the life story of a family through their most cherished memories by arranging their pictures in the correct order.

What’s in the demo?

 📖 Tutorial level
 🧩 3 levels from the full game

notes.title: Steam Page Update and Exclusive First Look!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’re excited to share some updates on our Steam page and invite you to an exclusive first look at Instants, available only on select dates! 👀

Steam page: What's new?

The biggest change—and the one that we are more excited about—is that our Steam page is now available in 11 different languages! We want everyone to enjoy Instants without language being a barrier, and this is the first step. Now, you can view our store page in:

 English
 Spanish
 German
 French
 Italian
 Simplified Chinese
 Japanese
 Russian
 Korean
 Catalan

We have also updated some screenshots and GIFs to better reflect the current quality of the game. Plus, we have polished the overall look of the Description to make it prettier ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149248/91b30a984a8af4a85de663c8f5734a672c5a4461.png

🎮Exclusive first look of the game

So, the Steam page looks awesome, but we know you’re eager to see the game in action. 
Here’s the plan: we’ll be streaming a gameplay video of Instants exclusively for Cozy Quest!

Mark your calendars: Catch our developer's playthrough during the Cozy Quest event, from November 14th to 18th. This is your chance to get a first look at Instants! Check our Steam page during the event to see the broadcast ✌️

Enflame Team 💖
